name: Hase Chieri
source:
A rookie social studies professor at your school. While she's quite good looking, most men can't see past her glasses and plain fashion sense. Living the studious life until now she hasn't had much experience in the world, though she's heard a lot of stories from her best friend Mamiko... She's had a hard time getting her students to pay attention in class, so she's especially grateful for your devotion.

[from [url=http://www.jastusa.com/cherry/characters/characters.html]official English site[/url]]
